_label: PROVISIONAL template, NOT RUN. llama.cpp llama-server, --moe-cache-mib variant: GLM-5.3-Flash with the experts of the first NCMOE layers in RAM (-ncmoe) and a GPU cache for them (--moe-cache-mib, LRU, misses copied over PCIe; split among the GPUs like the layers). Flags: llama.cpp tools/server/README.md @79e2e74 (82 -ncmoe, 83 --moe-cache-mib, the rest as in llamacpp-server.json); the cache exists only in builds >= c811cb8f0 (ROADMAP R1.4). llama.cpp mainline knows only the 'glm5-next' architecture string (src/llama-arch.cpp:158 @79e2e74, read here), not the 'glm5next' of the GGUF on the 3x3090 host (AGENTS.md; docs/reassessment/research/R2-engines.md:136), so this template needs a glm5-next GGUF (set GLM_GGUF; the weights for the 4x4080 server are an owner decision, ADR-005/ADR-009). Check every flag against `llama-server --help` on the server (artifacts/engine/flags_check.json).

_notes.safety_rules: scripts/r1/safety_rules.py checks this file before any step (run_r1.py refuses a violating config, exit 2); the rules are section (v) of docs/reassessment/PHASE-CLOSE-2026-10-11.md, accepted by the owner, applied as configuration guards only (no upstream patch in the R1 build). Rule 1: -np 1 stays explicit; no speculation in this template. Rule 2: --chat-template-file ${REPO}/templates/glm-5.3-flash/chat_template.jinja after --jinja (the built-in template leaks the previous turn's reasoning: risk matrix item 1); model.chat_template_sha256 is checked against the file and recorded in artifacts/orchestrator/safety_rules.json. Rule 3: clients never send "reasoning_content": null (HTTP 500 at common/chat.cpp:422-423@79e2e74); tools/gateway/gateway.py drops it. Rule 6: slot files are restored only through tools/kv/session_store.py, never by a raw /slots?action=restore of an unchecked file (N8). Rule 8: no manifest yet, so model.weights_unverified_reason marks every run UNVERIFIED; set the manifest and drop the reason before a run that is meant to count; a GGUF from the epyc-ai host only after tools/hostcheck/glm_gguf_check.sh.
_notes.cache_reuse: --cache-reuse is left out: at llama.cpp 79e2e74 it is inert for qwen4exp (IMRoPE: n_pos_per_embd > 1, so get_can_shift() is false and the server disables it, src/llama-kv-cache.cpp:1208-1217, tools/server/server-context.cpp:1318-1327, checked by the lead) and on glm5-next it shifts the reused chunk and then re-processes the whole prompt (CONFIRMED on CPU by N7, docs/evidence/2026-10-10-n7-server-hybrid-cpu.md finding 5, branch claude/n7-server-hybrid-cpu); prefix reuse of these hybrid models comes from the context checkpoints
_notes.LLAMA_BIN: bin/ of the llama.cpp build of scripts/engines/build_engine.py (/srv/llm/engines/current-llamacpp -> /srv/llm/engines-build/llama.cpp); the commit is engine.pin = tools/engines/pins.json[llama.cpp] (79e2e74eb, contains c811cb8f0 and d6cf9acb2); step engine_build_check compares ${LLAMA_BIN}/../build-info.json with the pin (sha, sm_89 cubins, sha256 of every built file) and does not start the engine on a mismatch. Build: python3 scripts/engines/build_engine.py --engine llama.cpp --arch 89 --src-root /srv/llm/engines-src --build-root /srv/llm/engines-build
_notes.experiment: B1 'separately with --moe-cache-mib' (docs/reassessment/EXPERIMENTS.md) and D1-moe-cache-policy.md; the same command without --moe-cache-mib is the baseline row (copy this file and drop the two tokens)
_notes.GLM_GGUF: first shard of a glm5-next GGUF with experts >= 4 bpw; the default path is a placeholder that does not exist, so weights_verify is skipped (no manifest) and quant_audit fails until it is set. Candidates from N15 (GGUF headers read by HTTP range on a CI runner, no weights downloaded; docs/evidence/2026-10-11-n15-gguf-headers.md on branch claude/n15-gguf-headers, not re-read here: Hugging Face is not reachable from this sandbox): unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF @a38483c8 UD-Q4_K_XL is glm5-next (185.983 GiB, experts 4.874 bpw, lowest matrix 4.5 bpw, expert_group_count 1), so the host's glm5next files are PROVISIONAL an earlier upload (compare the sha256 of shard 1 with the LFS sha256 b59c0300...); ggml-org/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF @c259a9f Q4_K (168.9 GiB, MTP in separate files). Set the revision and a manifest before a run
_notes.NCMOE: PROVISIONAL: more layers on the CPU than the plain -ncmoe row (17 of 42 MoE layers fit the uniform-routing placement of tools/roofline.py for UD-Q4_K_XL: resident 60.7%) to leave VRAM for the cache; tune on the server
_notes.MOE_CACHE_MIB: PROVISIONAL: 24 GiB in total over 4 GPUs; must fit next to the layers and KV
_notes.HIT: PROVISIONAL preregistered input: share of expert reads served from VRAM. Static share (42-24)/42 = 0.43 plus cache hits, which are UNKNOWN until measured (M1/M2); 0.6 is an assumption. vs_roofline uses the same value: a measured/bound ratio above 1 means this input is wrong
_notes.bpw: PROVISIONAL: Q4_K experts 4.5 bpw, dense 8.5; replace with the class bpw of this run's artifacts/quant/quant_audit.json
_notes.mode: overlap no: llama.cpp computes a layer's CPU experts or copies cached experts, without overlapping them with the GPU part (tools/roofline.py decode() docstring); miss pcie: misses are copied over PCIe (D1-moe-cache-policy.md)
